### Observed differences

- Participation shifted sharply: in the earlier window A22 ran in about 61 in 100 traces and each of A27, A28, A33 and A34 in about 39 in 100; in the later window A22 runs in about 99 in 100 traces while each of the four runs in only about 1 in 100 (2 of 200 traces). [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- A27, A28, A33 and A34 behave as a block: in the earlier window every trace containing one of them contained all four (pairwise co-occurrence about 39 in 100, matching each one's participation), in varying internal order; in the later window they co-occur in about 1 in 100 traces. [REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020]
- A22 and the block are mutually exclusive: in the earlier window about 61 in 100 traces contained A22 without any of the four and about 39 in 100 contained the four without A22; in the later window about 99 in 100 contain A22 only. [REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010]
- Routing out of A21 moved accordingly: transitions to A22 rose from about 61% to about 99% of A21's observed outgoing transitions, while transitions into A27, A28, A33 and A34 together fell from about 39% to about 1%. [DIR002, REL001, REL002]
- Order and placement corroborate this: A21 precedes A22 and A22 precedes A23 in about 99 in 100 later traces (about 61 in 100 earlier); A21 sits two positions before A23 in about 99 in 100 later traces versus about 61 before, while the earlier branch cases placed A21 five positions before A23 with the four block activities in between and before A23 (about 39 in 100, now about 1 in 100). [REL001, REL006, LAG001, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014]
- A23's typical position within the trace moved slightly earlier, from about 0.56 to about 0.54 of the trace. [POS001]
- A separate routing shift at A07: the share of outgoing transitions to A06 rose from about 20% to about 40%, the share to A08 fell from about 46% to about 26%, and A09 stayed at about one third. [DIR001]
- Later-window statements about the block's internal routing, lags and positions rest on only about 2 traces and are weak. [DIR003, DIR004, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the alternative route which replaces A22 with a block of A27, A28, A33 and A34 between A21 and A23 is now rarely executed: in the earlier window roughly 39 in 100 traces left A21 into this four-activity block before reaching A23, whereas in the later window about 99 in 100 traces run A21 → A22 → A23 and the block appears in only about 1 in 100 traces. [OCC002, DIR002, REL001, REL006, LAG001, REL015]

Supporting signs: 43 evidence items qualified, many times the roughly 0.52 expected by chance across the 105 tested units, and every item's difference exceeds about 99.5% of random re-splits of the pooled traces. Participation, routing, co-occurrence and order indicators all move consistently and complementarily — A22's rise from about 61 to about 99 in 100 traces mirrors the block's fall from about 39 to about 1 — a combination that sampling variation alone is unlikely to produce. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009]

Limitations: the many relational and lag items largely restate one underlying trace-level shift rather than serving as independent confirmations, and every later-window statement about the block's internal routing, lags or positions rests on about 2 traces. A competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is a sampling difference in variant frequencies — the later window catching the block at an unusually low ebb — though this would require 2 of 200 traces against an earlier rate of about 39 in 100, with A22 exactly mirroring the shift. The routing change out of A07 is a further difference that this hypothesis does not cover. [DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009]
